children: GameStop (GME) shares climbed about 3% in early trading Tuesday after CEO Ryan Cohen disclosed another large purchase of the video-game retailer's stock.
Cohen bought 1,150,680 shares on Sept. 21 through multiple open-market transactions. The shares changed hands at prices between $22.76 and $23.02, with a weighted average of $22.9375.

The purchase adds about $26.4 million to Cohen's direct investment in GameStop. Following the transaction, he directly held 40,498,522 shares, while his beneficial ownership, including warrants, stood at about 8.7% of the company.

The latest transaction comes after Cohen also purchased GameStop shares earlier in September. The SEC filing said the latest shares were bought with personal funds and were not tied to a reported Rule 10b5-1 trading plan.

title: GameStop Stock Rises After CEO Ryan Cohen Buys Millions in Stock
